title: 情绪低迷时：生物科技和AI设备被点名，上证3800点等什么催化？
speaker: How Hong

segments.en: Yeah, I think right now, because the sentiment is so depressed, and therefore we shouldn't be as depressed as the rest of the crowd.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为现在，因为情绪如此低迷，因此我们不应该像其他人那样悲观。

segments.en: In the sense that AI is... What do you buy? I think the biotech, for example.
segments.zh: 从AI的角度……买什么？我认为比如生物科技。

segments.en: The biotech is offering good money here today. I think AI equipment names, for example,
segments.zh: 生物科技今天提供了良好的收益。我认为比如AI设备类。

segments.en: the CPO names in China and also here in Hong Kong, they are offering good prospect of return.
segments.zh: 中国和香港的CPO类公司，它们提供了良好的回报前景。

segments.en: And I think in general, with the Asia, the Shanghai Composite, it's 3,800 points,
segments.zh: 总的来说，亚洲方面，上证综指在3800点，

segments.en: and also with the Hengsen Tech and about 4,300 points, they all offer really good risk to return racial,
segments.zh: 恒生科技指数在4300点左右，它们都提供了非常好的风险回报比，

segments.en: except that all of us are waiting for catalysts for them to come back.
segments.zh: 只是我们都在等待催化剂让它们回升。
